rebus.title: Rebus puzzle

images.alt: HE’S and HIMSELF side by side, split by a slash

rebus.explain: Look at where the words sit and how they are written: HE’S is beside HIMSELF.

rhyming.title: Rhyming mashup
rhyming.explain: Swap each word for one that means the same, so the two answers rhyme: artificial is fake, a reptile is a snake.

name.title: Name mashup
name.text: Name Mashup: Teen detective of mystery novels who starred in E.T.
name.explain: Two famous names that share a word, joined on it: Nancy Drew + Drew Barrymore.

soundalike-countries.title: Sound-alike country
soundalike-countries.text: Identify the country represented by the word puzzle: Male Cow + Mr. Busey + A
soundalike-countries.explain: Answer each clue, then say the pieces out loud: Bull + Gary + A sounds like Bulgaria.

soundalike-cities.title: Sound-alike city
soundalike-cities.text: Identify the international city represented by the word puzzle: Window Material + Chinese Strategy Game
soundalike-cities.explain: Answer each clue, then say the pieces out loud: Glass + Go sounds like Glasgow.

crossword.title: Crossword clue
crossword.text: Breads, cakes, etc.: _ _ K E _ _ O _ D _
crossword.explain: Each _ is one missing letter. The whole answer goes in as ONE piece, even when it is more than one word: BAKEDGOODS. Typing BAKED GOODS counts too.
